task.text:
The tables below provide information about the consumption and production of potatoes in five different regions in 2006.
Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

paragraphs.text: The two tables compare potato consumption per person and potato production in five regions in 2006. Consumption is measured in kilograms per person, whereas production is given in million tonnes.

Overall, Europe recorded by far the highest consumption figure, while Africa consumed the least. In contrast, Asia was the largest producer, closely followed by Europe, whereas South and Central America produced the smallest amount.

Regarding consumption, Europeans ate 96.1 kg of potatoes per person, which was the highest figure shown. North America ranked second at 57.9 kg. By comparison, Asia, South and Central America, and Africa recorded much lower figures of 25.8, 23.6 and 14.1 kg respectively.

In terms of production, Asia generated 131.2 million tonnes of potatoes, narrowly ahead of Europe at 126.3 million tonnes. North America recorded 24.7 million tonnes, while Africa and South and Central America produced 16.4 and 15.6 million tonnes respectively. These figures show a clear gap between the two leading producers and the remaining regions.

task.text:
The maps below show a beachfront area in Australia in 1950 and today.
Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

paragraphs: The given maps below show the development of a beach front area in Australia in 1950 and today.

Looking at the half of both two maps, in 1950, the playground located near the dining table, but today, the government has replaced the playground to the car park, so the connection between the main road and car park has also has created. The dining table and the pavilion haven't replace during the period. But today, the restaurant and the surf club have added in a beach front now. Surf club and restaurant located nearby each other and opposite the car park.

Moving to the half remaining, the lighthouse hasn't moved throughout the period. But in today, the new road has made by government to connect lighthouse to the main road. The car park in right north also hasn't moved. The another development is a new surf club has opened near the lighthouse, while the 25m pool and 50 pool haven't replaced or changed in 76 years.
review.overall: Em đã viết đủ độ dài và nhận ra hầu hết phần được thêm hoặc giữ nguyên. Tuy nhiên, bài thiếu overview nên ý chính của cả hai bản đồ chưa hiện rõ. Em cần dùng bị động khi mô tả phần được xây, thay hoặc nối đường; đồng thời kiểm tra chủ ngữ và động từ trong từng câu. Bản sửa giữ cách chia khu vực của em nhưng làm rõ vị trí và hai surf clubs.

paragraphs.text: The maps show how a beachfront area in Australia has changed between 1950 and the present day. They compare the locations of the facilities, pools and road network in the two periods.

Overall, several facilities and road links have been added to the area, whereas a number of original features have remained unchanged. In particular, the playground has been replaced by a car park, and a restaurant and two surf clubs have been constructed; however, the beach, pools, lighthouse, pavilion and dining table remain in place.

In the upper half of the map, the playground was located to the west of the dining table in 1950. It has now been replaced by a new car park connected to the main road. The restaurant and one surf club are situated on the western side, while the dining table and pavilion have remained in the central area. The original car park is still in the north-east.

In the eastern and lower parts, the lighthouse has not moved, but the main road has been extended around the original car park to reach it. A second surf club has been built above the 25m pool. By contrast, both the 25m and 50m pools have remained unchanged, as has the beach along the bottom of the area.
